notes.title: "Assault Armored Girls War Vasileia" major update!!
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45566389/68cfefe05d66921f807dbc3de353922dae50969a.png"]

■We are planning a major update for "Assault Armored Girls War Vasileia" to coincide with our summer sale!

The main changes are as follows.



◇A boss rush will be added as end content.

◇New weapons and accessories will be added.

◇User activity will be improved.

*You can access the end content by loading a cleared save data.



A new area will be added as end content where you can fight "Sisters" and "Gatekeepers" consecutively.

This will be a high-difficulty battle area where you cannot save midway.

Your clear time will be recorded.



Two new types of melee attacks, two new heavy melee attacks, and one new ranged attack will be added.

Several accessories will also be added.



We are very grateful for your feedback. We will make corrections that reflect your feedback and improve user activity. The following is an overview.



・Improved UI.

・Warnings will now be displayed when boost is running low or when locked on.

・Eliminated landing gaps.

・Improved AI.

・Changed the specifications of plasma damage.

　Even if the opponent is guarding, it will still reduce half of their boost gauge.

・Shooting attacks are now easier to hit even at close range.

・The tutorial stage has been simplified.

・Starting equipment has been changed.

・Weapon balancing has been adjusted.

・Bugs have been fixed.



The update is scheduled for June 25, 2025.

We have added updates to make "Assault Armored Girls War Vasileia" easier to play.

We hope that even if you were not satisfied with the initial version, you will play again.

We hope that even if you have completed "Assault Armored Girls War Vasileia" you will enjoy the end content.
